title: Work log
sub_optional: Note what you worked on: free text, a project, or both.
sub_required: Your company requires at least {percent} % of the worked time to be described – free text, a project, or both.
no_work: No working time on this day.
note_help: Free text; keep it short and factual.
note_placeholder: e.g. Measurements for the EMC report, customer call with Example AG
day_incomplete: This day is below the required {percent} %. Add what you did so the month can be signed off.
clock_out_prompt: You just clocked out. Please describe what you did today.
projects_sub: What people can book their work on. Team leads manage the projects of their teams, administrators all of them and the company-wide ones.
no_projects_help: Create a project so people can book their work on it. Free-text notes work without projects.
code_help: Identifier for reports: letters or numbers, up to 30 characters (e.g. AT2 or 4711).
team_help_admin: Company-wide projects are available to everyone; team projects only to that team.
team_help_lead: Projects you create belong to one of your teams.
active_help: Active (can be selected for new items)
report_desc: Logged hours per project and person.
search_projects: Search projects by name, code or team…
times_help: Exact times of this item; the duration follows from them: {duration}.
customer_help: Free text instead of a project, e.g. a customer number.
project_or_customer_required: A project or a customer reference is required.
